1. A device for communicating a driving ability level of a user, the device comprising at least a processor, a memory and a wireless transceiver, wherein the device is configured to:receive a communication from a medical device, wherein the communication comprises information relating to a condition of the medical device; and
send a communication to a vehicle;
wherein the information relating to a condition of the medical device is processed in order to determine a driving ability level of the user by the assignment of a category selected
from a group comprising a first category and a second category.
2. A device according to claim 1, wherein the device is configured to send the communication to the vehicle via a smart key associated with the vehicle.
3. A device according to claim 1, wherein the device is a smart key associated with the vehicle and storing a medical monitoring application.
4. A system comprising the device according to any preceding claim, further comprising the electronic warning system of the vehicle, and wherein the electronic warning system is
configured to:if the driving ability level of the user is assigned to the first category, not emit a warning signal; and
if the driving ability level of the user is assigned to the second category, emit a warning signal.
5. A system according to according to any preceding claim, wherein the driving ability level of the user is assigned to a category selected from the group further comprising a third category, and wherein the electronic warning system of the vehicle is further configured to:
if the driving ability level of the user is assigned to the third category, prevent the starting
of the engine of the vehicle or activate a safety assistant system.

6. A device according to according to any preceding claim, wherein the device is configured to:
if the driving ability level of the user is assigned to the second category, send a
communication to a navigation system.
7. A device according to any of claims 2 to 3, wherein the device is configured to:
store information relating to a medication dose history of the user;
determine, based on the stored medication dose history, a due time for a subsequent
medication dose administration; andwirelessly transmit data representing the due time for the subsequent medication dose administration to a smart key associated with a vehicle or to an electronic warning system of a vehicle.
8. A device according to claim 7, wherein the device is further configured to wirelessly communicate with an injection monitoring device and to receive dosing information from the injection monitoring device, the dosing information comprising a date, time and data representing an administered medicament dose, and wherein the device is further configured to update the stored medication dose history based on the received dosing information.
9. A device according to claim 8, wherein the device is further configured to determine a driving ability level of the user by inferring the user's physiological condition based on a comparison of the current time with the due time for the subsequent medication dose administration.
10. A device according to any of claims 7 to 9, wherein the device is configured to wirelessly transmit the data representing the due time for the subsequent medication dose administration to an electronic warning system of the associated vehicle and/or to wirelessly transmit an indication of a driving ability level of the user to the electronic
warning system of the associated vehicle.

11. A device according to claim 10, wherein the device is further configured to perform a plausibility check in response to receiving the data representing the due time for the subsequent medication dose administration, the plausibility check comprising confirming the received
information.
12. A device according to any of claims 10 to 11, wherein the smart key is further configured to:transmit an unlock signal to the associated vehicle;
in response to transmitting the unlock signal to the associated vehicle, compare the current time with the received data representing the due time for the subsequent medication dose administration; and
communicate the result of the comparison to the electronic warning system of the associated vehicle.
13. A system comprising a device according to claim 12, the system further comprising the electronic warning system of the vehicle, wherein the electronic warning system is configured to:receive the result of the comparison of the current time with the due time for the subsequent medication dose administration; and
if the current time is later than the due time, emit a warning signal.
14. A system according to claim 13, wherein the electronic warning system of the vehicle is further configured to:if the current time is later than the due time, prevent the starting of the engine of the
vehicle.
15. A system comprising the device according to any of claims 1 to 3 and the electronic warning system of a vehicle, wherein the device is configured to:
JDM/83298US2; DE2017/090-US-CNT[2] 31 receive a communication from a medical device, wherein the medical device is a permanent monitoring device and the communication comprises information relating to a physiological condition of a user;
wherein the information relating to a physiological condition of the user is processed in
order to determine a driving ability level of the user by the assignment of a category selected from a group comprising a first category, a second category, and a third category;
wherein the electronic warning system of the vehicle is configured to:if the driving ability level of the user is assigned to the second category, emit a warning signal, and/or
if the driving ability level of the user is assigned to the third category, prevent the starting of the engine of the vehicle or activate a safety assistant system.
